summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards foreign desk threatened to halt all oil and gas exports through the Strait of Hormuz as long as US attacks continue. US forces struck several bridges in Iran to cut logistics routes to Bandar Abbas and the Hormuz naval base. Multiple Iranian missile and drone attacks targeted US bases across Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, and the Gulf with air-defense responses activated.
key_points: Iran's Revolutionary Guards threatened to stop exporting oil or gas through the Strait of Hormuz while US attacks continue (Source: @N12chat/217816).
US military struck several bridges in Iran to cut supply routes to Bandar Abbas and the Hormuz naval base per a senior US official (Source: @VahidOnline/77172).
Five missiles were launched from Jam, Bushehr province toward the Gulf and Kuwaiti air defenses engaged Iranian missile and drone attacks (Source: @VahidOnline/77171).
Bahraini sources reported direct hits inside the al-Dhalaa camp housing US forces causing chaos; sirens urged residents to shelter (Source: @kianmeli1/89324).
Qatar airport activity was suspended and explosions were reported at the US al-Udeid base in Qatar (Source: @kianmeli1/89323).
IRGC announced a base of the enemy in Kuwait was set on fire, hitting a radar, weapon stores, two HIMARS, and missiles (Source: @SharghDaily/172484).
Jordan intercepted three Iranian missiles fired at its territory with no injuries or damage reported (Source: @N12chat/217822).
IDF killed Hamas platoon commander Nahad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Aruq in northern Gaza who infiltrated Israel on Oct 7 (Source: @New_security8200/202675).

sections.executive_summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards threatened to halt all oil and gas exports through the Strait of Hormuz as long as US attacks continue. US forces struck several bridges in Iran to cut logistics routes to Bandar Abbas and the Hormuz naval base. Iranian missile and drone attacks hit US bases in Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, and triggered air-defense responses across the Gulf.

points: The IRGC foreign desk threatened that as long as US attacks continue, Iran will not export oil or gas through the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @N12chat/217816).

A senior US official told WSJ that US forces targeted several bridges in Iran to cut logistics routes to Bandar Abbas and the naval base at the Hormuz strait; state TV reported strikes on bridges near Bandar Abbas and highways from neighboring provinces blocked (Source: @VahidOnline/77172).

Messages received reported five missiles launched from Jam county, Bushehr province toward the Gulf at 2:56–2:57; Kuwaiti air defenses engaged Iranian missile and drone attacks and Bahrain activated sirens after IRGC said it hit the US Fifth Fleet base in Bahrain (Source: @VahidOnline/77171).

IRGC communique 20 stated that in response to US strikes on civilians, Sepah aerospace forces in wave 12 operation Nasr 2 set a US base in Kuwait on fire, hitting a missile-defense radar, weapon stores, two HIMARS platforms and stored missiles (Source: @SharghDaily/172484).

Explosions were reported heard in Bandar Abbas and in Bushahr earlier in the day; Iranian army spokesman warned any continued hostile action will bring response exceeding enemy expectations and new confrontation arenas (Source: @almogboker78/17725).
US strike instructions were updated to include bridges and connectivity targets to add pressure on Iran per a Middle East source (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5041).

IDF killed Hamas platoon commander Nahad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Aruq in northern Gaza Strip in an airstrike; he infiltrated Israel on Oct 7 and trained terrorists recently (Source: @New_security8200/202675).

Security forces arrested several activists managing the 'Union of Health Committees' institution in Ramallah, declared a terrorist entity in 2021, as part of the Popular Front financial mechanism; indictments filed (Source: @inon_yttach/9504).
Navy commander Maj. Gen. Eyal Harel spoke at a memorial for Shayetet 13 fallen, citing 1000 days since Oct 7 and commando operations near and far, overt and covert (Source: @inon_yttach/9504).
IDF spokesperson defended the chief of staff against criticism, saying he represents the soldier in Golani and in the tank; no operational details of strikes given (Source: @yediotnews25/132790).

No additional Israel-domain combat developments explicitly tied to the Middle-East war beyond Gaza and West Bank arrests and the Oct 7 commemorative remarks were stated in messages (Source: @inon_yttach/9504).

IDF killed Hamas platoon commander Nahad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Aruq in northern Gaza Strip in a precise airstrike; he participated in the Oct 7 massacre and recent terror training (Source: @New_security8200/202675).
Southern Command forces are deployed in the Gaza area per the agreement and will continue to remove immediate threats, according to the IDF spokesperson (Source: @New_security8200/202675).

In the West Bank, Shin Bet with Judea and Samaria Border Police and IDF arrested activists of the Popular Front running the 'Union of Health Committees' in Ramallah as a terror finance node (Source: @inon_yttach/9504).

The institution was declared a terrorist organization by the defense minister in 2021 and unlawful association by Central Command; linked to the 2019 Ein Buvin bombing that killed Rina Shnerb (Source: @inon_yttach/9504).
Indictments were filed against some involved and more expected in coming weeks; the institution had resumed activity from Ramallah employing front activists (Source: @inon_yttach/9504).

End-of-day stats for Thursday 16 Jul 2026 recorded 88 alerts, 74 drone sightings; highest villages Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Kfar Tibnit with 13 each, Ali al-Tahir 13 targeted once (Source: @redlinkleb/31566).
Most active districts were Nabatieh 30, Bint Jbeil 23, Tyre 10; three drone strikes at Ali al-Tahir, Mifdoun, Kfar Tibnit and two air raids recorded (Source: @redlinkleb/31566).
A detonation heard in the south at Zawtar al-Sharqiya was attributed by the channel to enemy explosion activity (Source: @redlinkleb/31542).
No explicit Iranian or Israeli state military operation in Lebanon beyond drone and strike tallies and a local blast notation was stated in the provided messages (Source: @redlinkleb/31566).

IRGC claimed attack on al-Tanf base in eastern Syria at the Iraq-Jordan border triangle used by US forces; claimed destruction of a radar and several helicopters and many US personnel killed (Source: @asafroz/51553).

The same IRGC claim was echoed stating attack on US special ops command center in al-Tanf, Syria, destroying a radar system and several helicopters and killing numerous American personnel (Source: @shin_persian/8019).
A message noted that in practice the last US forces withdrew from Syria in April, casting doubt on the claimed current target (Source: @asafroz/51553).
Iraq's Islamic Resistance offered a $10 million bounty for assassination of US President Trump over killing of two resistance commanders (Source: @presstv/199084).
Strong explosions occurred in Erbil after attack by swarms of suicide drones; footage showed smoke from separatist HQ in northern Iraq (Source: @naya_foriraq/83553).
US Defense Secretary published a shot of targeting a control tower in Chabahar, indicating US strikes inside Iran coastal infrastructure (Source: @naya_foriraq/83570).

Kuwaiti army said its air-defense systems are engaging Iranian missile and drone attacks; explosions heard are from interceptions and citizens told to follow safety instructions (Source: @VahidOnline/77171).

Bahrain Interior activated sirens and urged residents to nearest safe location; IRGC said it hit the US Fifth Fleet base in Bahrain; camp al-Dhalaa with US forces reported direct hits and chaos (Source: @kianmeli1/89324).
Qatar airport activity was suspended and explosions reported at US al-Udeid base in Qatar; earlier reports noted attacks on US bases in Qatar (Source: @kianmeli1/89323).
King Fahd causeway, a 25 km bridge connecting Saudi Arabia and Bahrain, remained open despite reports of Iranian attempt to hit it; targets hit in Bahrain unclear (Source: @kianmeli1/89334).
IRGC communique said a US base in Kuwait was set afire hitting radar, weapon stores, two HIMARS and missiles, in response to US strikes on civilians (Source: @SharghDaily/172484).
Jordan intercepted three Iranian missiles fired at its territory with no casualties or damage reported (Source: @N12chat/217822).

sections.threat_assessment: The most acute threat is Iranian closure of the Strait of Hormuz to oil and gas exports, explicitly threatened by the IRGC foreign desk while US strikes persist (Source: @N12chat/217816). US bridge strikes on Bandar Abbas routes show intent to degrade Iranian logistics and pressure the state (Source: @VahidOnline/77172). Iranian missile and drone fires at US bases in Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar and toward Jordan demonstrate widening Gulf confrontation and air-defense strain (Source: @VahidOnline/77171). IRGC claims on al-Tanf and Kuwait base fires, plus Iraq resistance bounty on Trump, raise assassination and miscalculation risk (Source: @presstv/199084).
sections.regional_response: Gulf states activated missile defenses and public alert systems: Kuwait engaged targets, Bahrain sounded sirens, Jordan intercepted three missiles, and Qatar suspended airport activity (Source: @VahidOnline/77171). The King Fahd causeway stayed open despite Iranian threat reports, showing Saudi-Bahrain continuity of strategic land link (Source: @kianmeli1/89334). The White House stated Iran continues talking with the US and wants a deal even as Leavitt cited violations firing on ships (Source: @yediotnews25/132798). US strike guidance now includes bridges and connectivity to pressure Iran further (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5041).
sections.intelligence_notes: Messages show a mix of verified state reports and IRGC claims; IRGC said it hit a US base in Kuwait with radar and HIMARS destruction, but independent damage confirmation is absent (Source: @SharghDaily/172484). IRGC al-Tanf attack claim conflicts with reported US withdrawal from Syria in April, requiring validation (Source: @asafroz/51553). Citizen-sent missiles from Jam at 2:56–2:57 and Kuwaiti army confirmation indicate real-time Iranian fires toward the Gulf (Source: @VahidOnline/77171). US publication of Chabahar control tower strike suggests expanded targeting of Iranian coastal nodes (Source: @naya_foriraq/83570).
